targets.rawSql: SELECT stream, latest_at, dateDiff('second', latest_at, now()) AS age_seconds FROM (SELECT 'market metrics' AS stream, max(timestamp) AS latest_at FROM market_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY UNION ALL SELECT 'cross-venue metrics', max(timestamp) FROM cross_venue_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY UNION ALL SELECT 'derivatives metrics', max(timestamp) FROM derivatives_metrics WHERE timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY UNION ALL SELECT 'anomalies', max(detected_at) FROM market_anomalies WHERE detected_at >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY UNION ALL SELECT 'integrity events', max(calculated_at) FROM market_integrity WHERE calculated_at >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY stream LIMIT 10

panels.title: Persisted-data freshness
panels.description: Freshness is derived from persisted event timestamps, bounded to the last day.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS time, stream AS metric, events / 10.0 AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(ts, INTERVAL 10 SECOND) AS bucket, stream, count() AS events FROM (SELECT timestamp AS ts, 'market metrics' AS stream FROM market_metrics FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, 'cross-venue metrics' FROM cross_venue_metrics FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT timestamp, 'derivatives metrics' FROM derivatives_metrics FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT detected_at, 'anomalies' FROM market_anomalies FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) UNION ALL SELECT calculated_at, 'integrity events' FROM market_integrity FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(calculated_at)) GROUP BY bucket, stream) ORDER BY time, metric LIMIT 2000
